clips.title: The story
paras: Near Raven Hill Cemetery, Abercrombie asks travelers for help from his shack in western Duskwood. He seems a feeble, eccentric hermit, plagued by the horrors of the woods. He sends sympathetic travelers to Darkshire for peculiar reagents and supplies.

Abercrombie lives in a dilapidated shack near Raven Hill Cemetery, where Duskwood's decay has left him looking like a broken old man. He says he is only trying to survive the terrors of the woods and asks travelers to bring supplies, herbs, and thread from Darkshire. To anyone who does not know the region's history, he seems another unfortunate soul left behind as the province fell into ruin.
